ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows the South America region. Along the western coast there is a north-south-trending tall mountain system, namely the Andes Mountains; P is located near western South America, close to this mountain system. The “above climatic characteristics” in the question correspond to the “little precipitation and large temperature difference” in the previous question. Because the Andes Mountains block moist air currents, the leeward side of the mountains easily forms a low-rainfall environment, and at the same time the influence of terrain will also increase temperature differences, so the cause of this climatic characteristic at P is mainly terrain factors.
